svg.title: From a handwritten equation to a numbered one
svg.desc: Illustrative example. You supply an equation written by hand or clicked together in an equation editor: x equals minus b plus or minus the square root of b squared minus 4ac, all over 2a. An equation editor, or an AI assistant that accepts images, gives LaTeX that goes between \begin{equation} and \end{equation}, with no dollar signs inside: x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2-4ac}}{2a}. Paste it into your chapter. The PDF shows the typeset fraction with its number, (2.3), at the right margin.
